text: Decision: we will use PostgreSQL for the inventory service because the team already runs it in production.
Preference: I like meetings scheduled in the morning, ideally before 11am, and no meetings on Friday afternoon.
The quarterly budget review is on March 14 in the large conference room.
Wifi password for the office guest network is rotated monthly; ask the front desk for the current one.
Decision: the mobile app release moves to a two-week cadence starting in April.
Correction: the quarterly budget review moved from March 14 to March 21.
Preference: when writing documents use plain short sentences and avoid jargon.
The backup job for the shared drive runs nightly at 02:30 and keeps thirty days of snapshots.
Flight to the Denver conference departs Tuesday at 7:45am from terminal B, confirmation code is in the travel folder.
Decision: adopt semantic versioning for the public client library and tag every release.
Allergy note: I am allergic to shellfish, so remind me when picking restaurants for team dinners.
The standing desk was ordered on January 9 and should arrive within three weeks.
Preference: coffee with oat milk, no sugar, medium roast.
Decision: we drop support for Python 3.8 in the next major release because it is end of life.
Correction: the Denver flight now departs Tuesday at 9:10am, not 7:45am, from terminal C.
Recipe idea: roasted cauliflower with tahini, lemon, and toasted pine nuts for Sunday dinner.
The gym membership renews on the first of each month and costs forty five dollars.
Decision: logs are retained for ninety days and then deleted to control storage cost.
The dentist appointment is June 3 at 2pm for a routine cleaning.
Preference: keep the thermostat at 20 degrees in winter and 24 in summer.
Reading list: finish the book on distributed systems, then the one on negotiation.
Decision: pick the blue colour palette for the new dashboard after the usability test.
Correction: gym membership price rose to fifty two dollars starting this month.
Car maintenance: oil change due at 60000 kilometers, tires rotated at the same visit.
The team retrospective happens every second Thursday at 4pm in the small room.
Decision: use Rust for the new command line tool to ship a single static binary.
Chat: asked about a good hiking trail near the lake; suggested the ridge loop, about eight kilometers, best in early autumn.
Chat: compared two laptops; chose the lighter one with 32 gigabytes of memory for travel.
Passport expires in November next year, renew at least six months ahead of any international trip.
Preference: use dark mode in every editor and terminal.
Decision: the on-call rotation changes weekly on Monday morning, handover notes go in the team wiki.
Correction: the on-call rotation handover moved to Wednesday morning after the incident review.
The garden irrigation timer is set to water at 6am for fifteen minutes every other day.
Chat: explained the difference between a mutex and a semaphore; I prefer examples with a parking lot analogy.
Birthday gift idea for my sister: a pottery class voucher or a good field guide to birds.
Decision: invoices are paid on the last business day of the month, net thirty terms.
The apartment lease ends on August 31 and the landlord needs sixty days notice before moving out.
Chat: practiced Spanish verbs; weak spot is the subjunctive, schedule twenty minutes of review daily.
Correction: the apartment lease end date is extended to October 31 after the renewal.
Decision: weekly planning happens Sunday evening, using a simple three column task board.
